{{- /*
llms-full.txt: the entire documentation corpus in one plain-text markdown
file (the GitBook/Prefect "llms-full" convention), so an AI agent can fetch
everything in a single request instead of crawling.

Generated only for the home page (see [outputs] home in hugo.toml). Mirrors
the section tree used by the concise /llms.txt index (theme template) and
honours "llms: false" front matter to opt a section or page out, and
"llmsFull: false" to keep a large generated catalog out of this file while
leaving it in the concise /llms.txt index.

Every entry carries its canonical URL and, where the page publishes one, the
URL of the same page as raw markdown, so an agent can jump to a single page
after reading the corpus. Section landing pages contribute their body text
too, and pages that Hugo hides from page collections with "build.list: never"
(the generated VQL reference and Artifact Reference catalogs) are picked up by
walking the content directory.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description | default "" }}

How to use this file:
- Every entry starts with its title, its canonical URL, and (where available)
  the URL of the same page as raw markdown.
- /llms.txt is the concise index; this file is the full documentation corpus.
- Large generated catalogs that are left out are listed at the end.

{{- range where (where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false) "Params.llmsFull" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-full-section" dict "context" . "level" 2 }}
{{- end }}
{{- $rootPages := where (where (where site.RegularPages "Section" "") "Params.llms" "ne" false) "Params.llmsFull" "ne" false }}
{{- if $rootPages }}
{{ "\n" }}## Root Pages
{{- range $rootPages -}}
{{ template "llms-full-page" dict "context" . "level" 3 }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- $omitted := where (where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false) "Params.llmsFull" "eq" false }}
{{- if $omitted }}
{{ "\n" }}## Omitted sections

The following sections are large generated catalogs and are intentionally
left out of this file. Fetch them directly when needed:

{{- range $omitted }}
{{- $count := add (len .RegularPages) (len (partial "llms-hidden-pages.html" .)) }}
- {{ .Title }}: {{ .Permalink }} ({{ $count }} pages; raw markdown at {{ .Permalink }}index.md)
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

---
Generated on {{ now.Format "2006-01-02 15:04:05 UTC" }}
Site: {{ .Site.BaseURL }}

{{- define "llms-full-section" -}}
{{- $context := .context -}}
{{- $level := .level | default 2 -}}
{{- $headerHashes := strings.Repeat $level "#" -}}
{{- $body := partial "llms-page-body.html" $context -}}
{{- $meta := printf "URL: %s" $context.Permalink -}}
{{- with $context.OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ $meta = printf "%s\nMarkdown: %s" $meta .Permalink }}{{ end -}}
{{ "\n" }}
{{ $headerHashes }} {{ $context.Title }}
{{ $meta }}
{{ with $body }}
{{ . }}
{{ end }}
{{- range where (where $context.RegularPages "Params.llms" "ne" false) "Params.llmsFull" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-full-page" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- range where (where $context.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false) "Params.llmsFull" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-full-section" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- range partial "llms-hidden-pages.html" $context }}
{{ template "llms-full-page" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "llms-full-page" -}}
{{- $context := .context -}}
{{- $level := .level | default 3 -}}
{{- $headerHashes := strings.Repeat $level "#" -}}
{{- $body := partial "llms-page-body.html" $context -}}
{{- $meta := printf "URL: %s" $context.Permalink -}}
{{- with $context.OutputFormats.Get "markdown" }}{{ $meta = printf "%s\nMarkdown: %s" $meta .Permalink }}{{ end -}}
{{ "\n" }}
{{ $headerHashes }} {{ $context.Title }}
{{ $meta }}
{{ with $body }}
{{ . }}
{{ end }}
{{- end -}}
